description: This file defines the 'Dish' result class for the Coocook schema, representing a dish entity in the database with its columns, relationships, and associated methods.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Dish
classes.description: Represents a dish entity in the database, including its columns, relationships, and methods for managing dish data.

methods.name: delete_update_items
methods.description: Deletes associated ingredients and then deletes the dish itself within a transaction.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Returns a hashref with dish data and the associated meal date for editing purposes.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the project associated with the meal of this dish.
